critique: The render convincingly has the intended Large Snow 3D character: black background, detailed snowflake sprites, bright and dark orientation variation, and several prominent large flakes. Frame t1 has a suitably spacious composition. By t4, however, the visible population is much denser, especially through the center and lower half, with many smaller/darker flakes and cropped edge flakes making the field feel busy rather than clean and large-flake-led. The temporal buildup remains the main mismatch.

suggestions.why: Halve particle life so the mature t4 frame sheds older particles instead of retaining a much denser population than t1, while preserving the current large-snow emission character.
